title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Convert Word (.docx) To HTML (.html) within BC (No control add-in and APIs)
summary: Converting Word (.docx) files to HTML (.html) format within Business Central using the built-in ConvertWordToHtml procedure from codeunit 9651 without requiring control add-ins or external APIs. The post demonstrates two practical approaches: converting attachments in Document Attachment Details and uploading Word documents for conversion.
key_points: Business Central provides a standard method via codeunit 9651 'Document Report Mgt.' with the ConvertWordToHtml procedure
The conversion can be performed on Word files stored as document attachments or uploaded directly
Implementation uses TempBlob codeunit to handle file streaming and conversion
Some Word documents with unsupported package content may fail conversion with a specific error message

quotes.text: If you encounter a file that cannot be converted, the following error message will be displayed
quotes.why_it_matters: Alerts developers to potential conversion failures with unsupported Word document structures and helps with error handling
